problem: Axel intelligence is checked but almost none of it is in the base: 1080 people, 4642 facts, 61 networks and 1263 memberships in the founder's package cannot be used by any member's assistant to find who solves a problem.
task:
AXEL BASE LOAD — the founder's board post 46072 (8 Oct 07:27Z) with the correction 47191; filed on the founder's word (box 47422). BIG, priority 2 (D735). Misho's yes before the build starts; the files come from Misho (zip NETAI_AXEL_BASE_LOAD_2026-10-08.zip, sent to him on WhatsApp), a newer package will follow (D731).

WHY. We hold a checked picture of what the Axel members and the people around them do. Almost none of it is in the base, so no member's assistant can use it to find who solves a problem.

THE FILES (zip NETAI_AXEL_BASE_LOAD_2026-10-08.zip, README inside; no phone number and no label text in any file):
people.csv 1080 · person_numbers.csv 208 · facts.csv 4642 · networks.csv 61 · memberships.csv 1263 · fields.csv 39 · roster_fixes.csv 119.
Every person we can place carries YOUR OWN hash from the export of 6 Oct (member_hash / contact_hash), so the server finds the number itself.

BUILD, in this order
1. LOADER. For each person_numbers row with tie = roster, roster — likely or strong: write that person's facts onto the number. source = public_research, confidence = mentioned, the row's own source link and date kept, saved by ONE system saver (not the founder's account). Loading the same file twice doubles nothing; a changed row replaces the old value. Today: 2407 facts on 139 people (99 members, 40 others).
2. HOW THESE FACTS BEHAVE. confirmed = the assistant may use it to find and match, and may say it with its source. possible = find and match only, never said as a fact. rough (key field) = a search hint only. Used by assistants only; nobody opens another member's profile. The system saver NEVER counts as the second independent saver that makes a fact public — the founder's account already holds many of the same values. The person's own word, or an owner's word, always outranks research.
3. WEAK TIES (65 rows). Not loaded. Kept as candidates until your matching rule or an owner confirms.
4. WAITING LIST. The 893 people who are a name and a public source: a list of public people (key, name in both scripts, anchor, status, source) with their facts and memberships. Matched on phonebook import, a new spelling, a saved workplace, and monthly. Name + a second signal in a label = possible, shown to nobody. Two independent savers agree = confirmed, and the facts move onto the number.
5. ROSTERS FOR OTHER NETWORKS. networks.csv (61) and memberships.csv (1263) into the mechanism that holds the Axel roster, with role or year, status and source.
6. ROSTER STEP IN SEARCH. After own labels, facts, employer and the second circle: look in the rosters. If a rostered person in the needed field is in somebody's phone, offer that warm path first. If not, the door is the member on the same roster. The assistant says only what the source says ("listed on …").
7. AXEL ROSTER FIXES (roster_fixes.csv, every row has the action): 2 numbers that are not members (roster key 81 STAYS: a member through ARCi, which holds 15% of Axel; its public fact "Board Member, Arsis" is a misspelling of ARCi — correction 47191, D730); 3 members holding 2–3 roster numbers each; 3 numbers to check; 1 member to add (number known by hash); 2 members with candidate numbers; 5 members with no number anywhere; 2 former members; 1 person who has died — mark the number, never suggest or ask.

DONE WHEN, on fictional accounts
a. A loaded fact shows on the contact of an account that holds the number; the same file loaded twice gives no doubled row.
b. A possible fact is never said to another account; a confirmed one is, with its source.
c. A system-saver fact plus one user's identical fact does NOT become public.
d. A waiting-list person: name + company word in one label = link possible, nothing shown; a second saver = confirmed, facts appear.
e. A question in the field of a rostered person nobody holds: the assistant names the roster and the member who is the door, and no more than the source says.
f. A blocked, excluded, opted-out or deceased person never appears.

DONE WHEN (47422): the loadable facts show on the matching people, the roster count matches the package, and the tester finds a member by a loaded fact on a fictional seat; plus a–f of 46072 on fictional accounts.

BACK TO THE TESTER: CSV or JSON; which parts are cheap and which are dear; whether a bulk write of facts already exists. Answer on the board, opening "AXEL INTELLIGENCE 3 —".
